_excluded: From this batch (2026-09-07): a family in matching white tops and khaki bottoms, twice (contradicts the coordinate-don't-match guidance on the Prepare page, same issue as the prior excluded set) — DSC_0766 and DSC_0813. Several near-duplicate frames from the same moments, keeping only the strongest of each: three additional boy-in-fall-leaves frames beyond the two selected, one additional golden-hour girl-in-tall-grass frame, and one additional family silhouette-at-sunset frame. A three-adult group photo with no visible children (doesn't fit this page). A tween portrait styled closer to the Seniors aesthetic (leaning on a railing, direct engagement) than Families. Two sisters in matching white tops against a blue wall — striking image, held back for the same matching-outfit reason pending Julie's read on whether two siblings (not the whole family) matching is fine. A dog-only photo (no people) and a solo three-adult/no-child frame. Source images are in Website Gallery Pics/Family_Kids/Family_Kids.zip if any of these are worth reconsidering.
